title: Parikshaa content: bundle for bulk upload
description: One upload. Either a single JSON file (manifest + items inline), or a folder/ZIP with manifest.json at its root and one item per *.json file anywhere below it, where any string may be {"$file": "relative/path"}. See docs/content/CONTENT-FORMAT.md section 3.

items.description: Inline items (single-file bundle). A folder bundle leaves this out.

bundle_id.description: Stable name of this batch, e.g. dsa-arrays-batch-03.

version.description: Raise on every re-upload of the batch.

generated_with.description: Tool and how it was used, free text (e.g. 'AI drafts from docs/content/prompts, edited by the team').

owner.description: Who owns the content (Parikshaa / the owner's company).

terms.description: e.g. 'All rights reserved; written for Parikshaa.'

statement.description: Every item is our own: own stories, statements, tests, solutions and editorials; nothing copied from LeetCode, GeeksforGeeks, InterviewBit, HackerRank, Codeforces, IndiaBix or any book or site we do not own.

checks.description: What was done to check it (validator duplicate check, reviewer read, search spot-checks).

tracks.description: Tracks (courses) the items' placement refers to. Modules in order.
